sections.h2: A healthcare app developer you can meet in Chennai
paras: Elevate Aura is a healthcare app development company in Chennai run by its founder, Ragul Sekar, who scopes, builds, publishes and supports every app himself. For Chennai customers the first meeting happens at your premises: the OP counter, the ward, the lab, or the service bay where the engineers load their vans.

Both of the client platforms cited on this site were built for Chennai businesses. Carna Medicare, a medical-equipment distributor, runs a 12-module operations platform with a React Native field-staff app. Medline Robotics, a medical robotics company, runs an e-commerce and distributor platform with 253 product and city SEO pages. Aura Business is running two distribution businesses in Chennai today.
Outside Chennai the same work is done remotely, with in-person visits possible elsewhere in Tamil Nadu by travel.

sections.eyebrow: Why local matters for a healthcare app
sections.h2: Some things about a hospital cannot be learned on a video call.
sections.lead: The workflow an app must fit is physical: where the queue forms, where the signal drops, where the engineer parks.

items.p: Seeing how tokens are actually called at your OP counter shapes the patient app better than any requirements document.
Walking the basement imaging suite or the ICU shows exactly where offline mode must work.
Watching engineers load spares at 8 am tells us what the job card must capture and what it must not ask.
A nurse or front-desk assistant tries a working build in person and tells us what is wrong, in Tamil or English.
When the app matters to the hospital, a developer who can be at your site the same day is a different kind of support.

sections.h2: Healthcare app development in Chennai, answered.

items.q: Will you visit our hospital or office in Chennai?
items.a: Yes. Discovery for Chennai projects is done in person at your premises, and reviews during the build can be in person or on WhatsApp. Contact +91 95789 71156 or elevateauraofficial@gmail.com to arrange a visit.

items.q: Do you work with businesses outside Chennai?
items.a: Yes. Elsewhere in Tamil Nadu an in-person visit is possible by travel; across the rest of India and abroad the work is done remotely with support on WhatsApp. The build and the store release are the same either way.

items.q: What have you built for Chennai clients?
items.a: A 12-module operations platform with a React Native field app for Carna Medicare, and an e-commerce and distributor platform with 253 SEO pages for Medline Robotics. Read the Carna Medicare and Medline Robotics case studies.
React Native or Flutter for the app, Supabase or Azure for the backend, Next.js or WordPress for the web. The choice is made with you after the site visit and explained in the scope.

items.q: Do you also supply the hospital or dealer software behind the app?
items.a: Yes. HIMS for hospitals and clinics, AuraPACS for imaging and Aura Business for dealers and distributors are all built by Elevate Aura, and each has a live demo. See hospital software in Chennai and PACS software in Chennai.

items.q: How long does an app take?
items.a: Live in 30 working days where scope allows. The scope is fixed after the site visit, and you see working builds on your own staff's phones during the project.
